mechanical.note: Mechanical edits go to gpt-implementer too (2026-09-26); cursor-seat and devin-seat are optional capacity.

admit.ok_on_pace: a min_pace entry passes the pace gate when its pool's pace is known and >= min_pace and the pool's eligibleAccounts count, when present, is above 2
admit.behind_or_low: a min_pace entry fails the pace gate when its pool's pace is unknown or below min_pace, or when the pool's eligibleAccounts count is present and 2 or less; an entry with no min_pace has no pace gate
admit.critical: the same pace gate as behind_or_low (a count of 1 is 2 or less)
admit.exhausted: an entry whose pool status is exhausted is skipped
admit.every_entry: paced or not, an entry is skipped when its model alias does not resolve, its seat is down, or it shares the author's vendor on a cross-vendor class; in a class that declares auditors it is also skipped when no auditor is declared for its vendor, the auditor's model does not resolve, the auditor's pool is exhausted or has an eligibleAccounts count of 1 or less, or the auditor's seat is down

notes: Codex seats take --model <id> plus a separate --effort; the effort suffix is not a model name.

2026-09-22 canonical lineup (owner): no Fable, no Codex Astra, no gpt-5.6. Seats name family aliases (`aliases`); `route resolve <alias>` and `route pick` resolve them to the newest served, non-retired model, so a release needs no edit. Opus plans and verifies; Sol implements; the other vendor audits (classes.*.audit).

2026-09-25: Cursor and Devin accounts are registered in agent-lb (`seat accounts`, ~/.agent-lb/seats). cursor-seat and devin-seat dispatch through `seat run`, which picks an account, fails over on a limit or auth error and writes the receipt; /api/pools serves `cursor` and `devin` as cli_seat pools from the seat state. Neither vendor offers a supported API for subscription models, so there is no request-level route through the LB.
